author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The Batcave comes to the cave! Adam and Norm unbox and check out the prototype for a 1/6 recreation of the batcave from Batman (1989)! We marvel at the centerpiece of this diorama: the batcomputer with 12 functioning monitors with details sourced from screenshots, behind-the-scenes photos, and found parts from the original. Plus, a beautifully sculpted and painted Bruce Wayne figure and Batman's suit vault!

Learn more about the Jazzinc Dioramas Batcave model here: https://jazzincdioramas.com/batman
Check out Doggie Doc Designs builds here: https://www.doggiedocdesigns.com/ https://www.facebook.com/DoggieDocDesigns/ and https://www.instagram.com/doggiedoc_designs/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
